Sports · India

Indian athletes win multiple medals at Commonwealth Games

Indian judokas Asmita Dey and Harsh Singh won the country's first gold medals in the sport at the Commonwealth Games. Dey defeated Canada's Quach in the women's 48kg final, and Singh beat Australia's Katz in the men's 60kg final. In athletics, Gulveer Singh secured a silver medal in the men's 10,000m race, and Lovepreet Singh won a silver in weightlifting. Seema Punia earned a bronze in discus throw, and Mohammed Basil won silver in men's 100m Para-Athletics.
